title: Dialect area parts
description: names/dialect_areas_parts.geojson: one Feature per municipality of names/dialect_areas.csv, and one per municipality of Kreis Nordfriesland no row claims. `frasch build areas` writes it (frasch/build_dialect_areas.py) for the dialect-area review view alone (web `?areas`, web/src/dev/AreaPanel.tsx); nothing in the Python pipeline reads it.

properties.description: The file's own properties: what it was built from, and how.

source.description: The file name of the area list.

simplify_deg.description: The tolerance the geometry was simplified to, in degrees.

unassigned_ags.description: The municipality-key prefix of the district whose unclaimed municipalities are in the file; empty when there are none.

built_from.description: What the file was built from, as `$defs/built_from` of names/search-index.schema.json defines a stamp: the area list, the dialect registry and the extract.

features.description: The municipalities of the area list in its order, then the unclaimed ones by name.

part.description: One municipality. One that a row of the area list assigns has that row's dialect, note and line; one that no row claims has none of them -- above all no `dialect`, which is what keeps the dialect lookup from ever loading this file.

fid.description: The feature's number, stable within one build: the view's selection key.

assigned.description: Whether a row of the area list claims the municipality.

dialect.description: The registry tag of the dialect the row assigns it to; the registry has its label.

name.description: The row's `name`; of an unclaimed municipality its OSM name, empty when it has none.

osm.description: The row's `osm` cell, `relation/1; relation/2`; of an unclaimed municipality its relation. A reference is on one row only, so the first is the view's deep-link key.

line.description: The row's line in names/dialect_areas.csv (header = 1), for display.

km2.description: Its area in km², to one decimal.
